items.title: Qualcomm, SpaceX deal could reshape the future of 5G
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts, Jake Conley and Pras Subramanian, and guest Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski discuss Qualcomm (QCOM)'s deal with SpaceX (SPCX) to use its Dragonwing technology to power a terrestrial 5G network. The panel examines what the partnership could mean for the future of wireless connectivity.

items.summary: SpaceX is teaming with Qualcomm in push to turn Starlink into major US carrier.

items.title: Asia stocks mixed as chip rout triggers KOSPI trading halt; China outperforms
items.summary: Investing.com-- Asian stocks were mixed on Thursday, as a sharp selloff in semiconductor shares triggered a trading curb in South Korea, offsetting support from a steep decline in oil prices after Democrats' victories in the U.S. midterm elections.
